chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from 'Anbasah ibn Mus'ab, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about semen that affects a garment, while one does not know where its place is. He said: “He should wash all of it, and if he knows its place, then let him wash it.”

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by impurity
key_terms.الْمَنِيِّ: semen, treated here as a substance requiring purification from the garment
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it, meaning the entire garment when the impure spot is unknown
key_terms.مَكَانُهُ: its location, meaning the precise spot of the impurity
key_terms.يَغْسِلُهُ: he should wash it, indicating the required act of purification

ai.seo_question: What should be done if mani gets on a garment and its exact location is unknown?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding purification of clothing from mani. If the exact spot of impurity on the garment is unknown, the entire garment should be washed; if the location is known, washing that specific area is sufficient.
